description: PROP-AUTH-022 (REQ-AUTH-013: session 401 when link session TTL expired) at auth-flow.test.ts:441-457 calls validateLinkSessionRecord directly with a manually constructed LinkSessionRecord, rather than exercising the full integration path through handleStructuredAuthRequest with a session endpoint request and an expired backing record. This makes it a Tier 1 pure-core test masquerading as a Tier 2 integration test. The actual session endpoint path in handleStructuredAuthRequest (shell/index.ts:319-351) that does hash lookup, record retrieval, and validateLinkSessionRecord composition is never tested with an expired record. Carried over from iter2 FIND-104's concern pattern: Tier 2 tests calling pure functions directly.
